in_hebrew.name: Gildus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gildus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word gildus, meaning 'servant, follower, or rule'. Derived from the verb gaudere, meaning 'to rejoice'. In the Roman Empire, a gildus was a servant, follower, or a member of a guild. In Christianity, it can symbolize serving God and following His teachings.

in_greek.name: Gildus
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Rule, power
in_greek.long_meaning: Gildus είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Latin word gildus, meaning 'servant, follower, or rule'. Derived from the verb gaudere, meaning 'to rejoice'. In the Roman Empire, a gildus was a servant, follower, or a member of a guild. In Christianity, it can symbolize serving God and following His teachings.

in_latin.name: Gildus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Germanic element 'gold' meaning 'gold' + '-us' a suffix indicating a male person.
